The quotation is about a school funding formula ("Fair Funding") that links the size of the funding pot to deprivation and need. The specific mechanism is an intergovernmental/public funding allocation formula tied to socioeconomic need in education.

Primary: **I2** (Education and Research Institutions — the substance is school funding allocation)
Secondary: **H7** (State and Local Government / Intergovernmental Relations — the funding formula redistributes across jurisdictions based on need) and **I3** (Welfare, Well-Being, and Poverty — deprivation/need as the allocation criterion has a poverty-targeting dimension)

{"primary": "I2", "secondary": ["H7", "I3"]}
